items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: My father said that if your father is Thomas Marshall Riddick, that we are definitely of the same clan.

ctx.x: And I have the history of it all, or the gene, in other words, says that it began as far back as the year 1200. And there was a different spelling of the word Rarick, and this and that and the other, and Riddick, and this. All was pronounced, though, Riddick. And it meant red dirt dairy farms. There was a barony up in North Scotland, according to the gene. Now, no proof of mind, except the gene says that. And it was pronounced Riddick. And it said that there was a recording of a tract of land in Virginia passed…
